texts: mixed: the query asks the right thing — the reason for the Council's discussing, with the lantern as place, Year 1 and the past tense all bound — but "discuss burning wintergloss" puts a gerund clause in the direct-object slot, which the translator has no rule for: here the burning is spelled out as an event in its own right, while a statement of the same fact may instead tuck it inside the discussing, and then the question matches nothing. Rewrite as "Why did the Council discuss the burning of wintergloss at the Stilllight Lantern in Year 1?" — an "of"-phrase after the noun is the shape the translator handles, so the question and the stored fact come out the same way.
